text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober! It's Mejiro Doooberrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Reigning over the turf of Yodo, a 
brand-new queen! Her name is Mejiro 
Dober!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I... actually won...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (As Mejiro Dober, I have to... to Senpai—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent run. ...It is my 
complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Because you always shone so brilliantly 
ahead of me, Senpai, I was able to take on 
today's challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I will never, ever forget 
today's race for the rest of my life...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
By challenging me, you have proven that my 
path was the right one.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This is my thanks for that. And—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—From this moment on, I shall be the one 
who challenges you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run again. Someday, an even greater 
race than today."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Someday, definitely again...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, everyone is waiting. Go and 
show them all that you've got."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, thank you so much for your 
support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I will keep pushing forward. Aiming for 
greater heights, for an even brighter 
brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So please, keep watching me from now on. 
And please remember.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My name is Mejiro Dober. The mightiest 
queen who reigned over this Yodo—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A fierce crown for the noble Mejiro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Along with a new brilliance... The one 
blooming proudly in the new era of Mejiro 
is me! Mejiro Dober!
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

The cheers praising Mejiro Dober continued 
to roar on and on endlessly.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—And so begins our special feature on the 
Mejiro family's glory. First up, of 
course, is this umamusume! Having recently 
and splendidly claimed the queen's 
throne—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Dober! My, what a magnificent run 
that was...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, indeed! That sheer strength and 
brilliance! She truly possesses the 
radiance befitting an Umamusume to usher 
in a new era for the Mejiros!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
“Dober too, but Mejiro Bright as well! You 
can't forget about her. Especially that 
Tenno Sho (Spring)—!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ This brings us one step closer... 
doesn't it, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Still—we're just getting started.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"The New Glory of Mejiro"... Our era is 
just getting started...!!
